title: Independent native enrollment setup public authorizer v1
description: Only nativeStartupConfiguration/v3 carries this exact enrollmentSetupAuthorizer object, alongside mandatory existing enrollmentAuthorizer and enrollmentProxyEndpoint. v1/v2 remain closed and reject this addition. This is a separate dedicated Ed25519 key/purpose, not implicit delegation-key installation rights; cold admission must independently pin its public PEM and separate it from actual delegation, policy, response, CA, issuer and caller/target key roles. No private key, pathname, environment fallback or per-request root choice. Schema shape alone is not admission or installation permission.

publicKeyPem.description: Exact canonical public-only Ed25519 SPKI PEM bytes including final LF, at most16384 bytes. Runtime genuinely parses/re-encodes and rejects weak keys; this is not a path or embedded private key.

publicKeyPemSha256.description: Independent SHA-256 of exact PEM original; distinct from setup authorizerKeyId, which hashes actual DER SPKI. Matching self-declared bytes is not enclosing cold-configuration authority.
